n0.speaker: Daniel
n0.text: Jo. Early. Fish guy's late, which at this point I think is a metaphor.
n0.aside: He is polishing the same brass cleat he polished yesterday. And the day before.

choices.text: "I've got news, Dan. I signed with Salt Cathedral."

n1.speaker: Daniel
n1.text: ...Right. Good. That's... sure. That's really good.
n1.aside: He keeps polishing. The cleat has never been so clean.

choices.text: "I'll work out my notice. I promise."

n2.speaker: Daniel
n2.text: Mm. You're a terrible liar, Jo. It's one of the nicest things about you.

n3.speaker: Daniel
n3.text: I've had a contract in my desk for six years. Unsigned. It's the best thing I've ever not done.

choices.text: (Say nothing. Hold the ladder for him.)

n4.text: Daniel looks at the lake for a moment, then waves at it, like he does every morning, like he's checking someone is still there.

n0.speaker: Lux
n0.text: You look like you were hit by a very quiet truck.
n0.aside: She's tuning a string that is already in tune.

n1.speaker: Lux
n1.aside: Her hand tightens on the neck. It is the most honest thing she has done all week.

n2.speaker: Lux
n2.text: You can't make pancakes at noon and pretend it's normal. ...Go on, then.

n3.speaker: Lux
n3.text: Someone has to keep the pancakes warm for the people you leave.

n4.speaker: Lux
n4.text: Don't. Don't ask me that. I counted the tape, Jo. Don't make me say the number.
n4.aside: She is looking at the wet patch on the floor, not at you.

n5.text: Lux plays a chord that doesn't resolve. It hangs in the basement like breath on a cold day.

n0.speaker: Fitz
n0.text: Did I ever tell you about the winter the lake froze solid, and a man walked across to the far shore and came back wearing a different hat?

choices.text: "You've told me. It was a bus."
"Fitz, did you ever hear a bell at four in the morning?"

n1.speaker: Fitz
n1.text: That's a true story. Well. It happened to somebody.

n2.speaker: Fitz
n2.aside: He is drying the same glass. The glass is dry. He hums four notes without noticing.

n3.speaker: Fitz
n3.text: Nobody. A man I'm... telling a story about. Different bar. Forget it. Another?

end.text: The Low Water fills up. You are the drummer, and for ninety minutes the lake is just a rumour behind the amps.
